blocks.title: Na deze pdf kun je
bullets: het verschil tussen scheidbare en onscheidbare phrasal verbs gebruiken
voornaamwoorden op de goede plek zetten (pick it up)

de betekenis van veelvoorkomende partikels herkennen

head: Soort
Voorbeeld
Met it / him / them
rows: Turn off the TV. / Turn the TV off.
Turn it off. (nooit turn off it)
I'm looking forward to the holiday.

blocks.title: Net als scheidbare werkwoorden
blocks.text: Het Nederlands kent scheidbare werkwoorden: Ik zet de tv uit. Het Engels werkt deels hetzelfde: I turn the TV off. Het grote verschil: een voornaamwoord moet in het midden: Turn it off.

head: Partikel
Betekenis
Voorbeelden
rows: eat up, use up, tidy up, give up, grow up
slow down, cut down on, write down, turn down
find out, run out, work out, sort out, point out
take off, set off, put off, call off, turn off
carry on, go on, keep on, put on, get on
call back, pay back, come back, get back

blocks.title: Eén werkwoord, veel betekenissen
blocks.text: take off = opstijgen, uittrekken én een succes worden. pick up = oppakken, ophalen, een taal oppikken. De zin bepaalt de betekenis: lees altijd de hele zin.

rows: Een voornaamwoord staat in het midden.
I'm looking forward to see you.
I'm looking forward to seeing you.
I can't put up her behaviour.
I can't put up with her behaviour.
I get on well with her.

blocks.text: Vul het ontbrekende partikel in. De antwoorden staan op de laatste pagina.

items.q: The match was called ______ because of the rain.
items.full: The match was called off because of the rain.

items.q: I can't come ______ with a good idea.
items.full: I can't come up with a good idea.

items.q: She takes ______ her father. They're both very calm.
items.full: She takes after her father. They're both very calm.

items.q: It took him months to get ______ the flu.
items.full: It took him months to get over the flu.

items.q: I don't know the answer. I'll look ______ it.
items.full: I don't know the answer. I'll look into it.

items.q: Don't put ______ until tomorrow what you can do today.
items.full: Don't put off until tomorrow what you can do today.

items.q: She turned ______ the job because the salary was too low.
items.full: She turned down the job because the salary was too low.

items.q: How do you put up ______ that noise?
items.full: How do you put up with that noise?

items.q: My car broke ______ on the motorway.
items.full: My car broke down on the motorway.
You should cut down on sugar.

items.q: We ended ______ staying at a small hotel.
items.full: We ended up staying at a small hotel.

items.a: The meeting has been called off.

items.q: Ik kan goed met mijn baas overweg.
items.a: I get on well with my boss.
